newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Two Israelis wounded by petrol bomb near Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Two Israelis wounded by petrol bomb near Hebron.

text.p: Two Israeli soldiers were wounded when a petrol bomb was thrown at their vehicle near the West Bank town of Hebron on Tuesday, security sources said.
The army said it was checking the report. No other details were immediately available.
Israelis and Palestinians have failed in nearly two months of intensive talks to agree on terms for a partial Israeli troop withdrawal from Hebron, a flashpoint of Arab-Israeli violence.
Each side has accused the other of violating peace deals outlining Israel's pull out from parts of the West Bank including Hebron, where 400 Jewish settlers live among 100,000 Arabs.

"If he (Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu) thinks that I will accept his conditions or I will make concessions, he is wrong," Palestinian President Yasser Arafat told reporters in the West Bank city of Bethlehem on Tuesday.
Netanyahu told reporters at Ariel settlement in the West Bank: "We're not impressed by the threats but we are impressed with the fact that they don't want to conclude an agreement."
